geometry_notes: Main block parapet is ~11.7-12.0 m (lidar 11.7 along W14, 11.8-12 along W0, 12.3-12.6 near W1); the walls.json height 14.7 m is roof plant. Rows sum to 12.0 m (4.0 / 3.7 / 3.7 / 0.6), within 0.1 m of B2's floor lines across the shared wall.

Lidar roof extends ~3-3.5 m beyond the W0 line (all of W0) and ~3 m beyond the W14 line at s 62-73, while at W1 s 0-3 the ground reaches ~1-2 m inside the line. Either the footprint sits ~2-3 m SW of the lidar here or the lidar is shifted; the photos show flat walls with no overhang. ESC's analyst found a similar ~2-3.5 m mismatch on the shared annex (ESC W4/W6). Not corrected here.
W1 is shared for s 7.2-30.0 (B2 W4) and s 30.0-75.0 (STC W18); W2/W3 coincide with STC W17/W16. Only W1 s 0-7.2 is visible.
W14 s 39.2-57.6 is shared at levels 2-3 with ESC's annex (ESC W5); at ground it is the back of the open undercroft and must be drawn (brick, screen, entrance).

W4-W10 enclose the greenhouse (built ~2016). Lidar shows 0 m along W5/W6 and only 4.4-5 m elsewhere: the lidar predates the new greenhouse or missed the glass. The 2023 ortho matches the footprint. The south side is a zig-zag; the gaps W6.b-W7.a and W8.a-W7.b are unlisted short jogs.
The tall buff-brick tower and the block with the blue curtain-wall band seen behind the greenhouse in Earth views belong to STC (lidar 24 m at x<958; STC W15), not B1.
Low brick service block W11-W13 is ~7.5 m (lidar 6.6-9.2), two storeys.

W0.notes: Seen obliquely from the west end (sv_c0, sv_W0_m9Ef, 2014: the pair nearest the NW corner, then a wide pier, then the next pair) and through trees from the rock garden (sv_W0_3Ts4: pair / ~2-2.5 m pier / pair / pier). Earth W0 view is blocked by trees. Same strip system as B2 W1 and ESC W3; module (3.7 m pair + 2.1 m brick) taken from ESC W3, which matches the pixel estimates here (pair ~2.8-3.7 m, pier ~2-2.5 m). Count of 4 pairs is fitted to the length (medium confidence). sv_W0_3Ts4 hints that one ground-floor opening near s ~11-12 may be a door rather than a window (behind a boulder, unconfirmed). Ground: lawn with rock-garden boulders right up to the wall, no path along it.

W1.notes: Spans from walls.json: B2 W4 ends project to s 7.23 and 30.04 on this line (within 0.5 m), STC W18 (963.1,162.1)->(942.95,202.0) covers s 30.0-75.0. The open stub is plain brick with no openings in sv_c0, sv_W0_m9Ef and sv_W1_Hlv (2014); it is exactly B2's 'blank brick SW wall continuing ~8 m north past W0'. If the drawing code cannot hide part of a wall, draw s 7.2-75 as plain brick: it is never seen.

W14.notes: All facade photos are Street View Sep 2014 (no newer imagery; Earth W14 views are tree-blocked). Strip system identical to ESC W3 across the walk (same 1.3 m strips, 0.6 m pier inside the pair, 2.1 m brick between pairs); 6 pairs fitted so that pairs fall at s ~11.5-15.2 and ~23-27 as measured in sv_W14_9uN9 and the last pair ends ~0.8 m before the annex as in sv_W14_IUGd/-1wco. South 5.7 m (s 0-5.7) is behind conifers in every photo: assumed blank brick. Undercroft positions (screen s ~42.5, doors s ~45.7-49.1) differ by up to 4 m between sv_W14_IUGd and sv_W14_7QFW (pano positions); order and widths are reliable. North part from sv_W14_Jlgu: louvre slot s ~61.8-62.7, entrance bay s ~66.5-68.6, 6.8 m blank brick to the NE corner. Mechanical penthouse lidar 15.8 m sits ~3 m inside this wall at s 48-68 (see roof). Upper rows of s 39.2-57.6 are left as plain brick: ESC's annex abuts and covers them.
